rules.name: block-git-add-all
rules.reason: Use 'git add <specific-files>' to avoid committing secrets or large binaries.

rules.name: block-git-push-force
rules.reason: Force push can overwrite upstream history. Use a normal push or ask the user first.

rules.name: block-git-reset-hard
rules.reason: Hard reset discards uncommitted changes. Use 'git stash' or ask the user first.

rules.name: block-git-checkout-discard
rules.reason: This discards all unstaged changes. Use 'git stash' or ask the user first.

rules.name: block-git-restore-discard
rules.reason: This discards all unstaged changes. Use 'git stash' or ask the user first.

rules.name: block-git-clean-force
rules.reason: git clean -f permanently deletes untracked files. Ask the user first.

rules.name: block-git-branch-force-delete
rules.reason: Force-deleting a branch can lose unmerged work. Use 'git branch -d' or ask the user.

rules.name: block-git-config-global
rules.reason: Never modify global/system git config. Use project-local config or ask the user.

rules.name: block-rm-recursive-force
rules.reason: Recursive force delete is destructive. Remove specific files or ask the user first.

rules.name: block-go-clean-cache
rules.reason: Clearing Go caches slows builds. Only do this if the user explicitly requests it.
